messages:
sam_p: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands runtime section — thanks Maria and Jen for the deep dive. A few teams pinged me for concretely actionable items on latency regressions and the kernel/batching roadmap. Can we list short-term (1–2 weeks) and medium-term (1–2 months) owners and the expected outcomes?

maria_r: +1. I'll kick off: short-term: triage two highest-severity latency regressions (p99 tail) — owner: maria_r + joel_s. Goal: identify flaky kernel paths or bad batching heuristics and ship a hotfix if it's a config/heuristic bug.

kai_w: For context, the regressions are visible when seq_len distribution spikes and continuous batching groups very long and short requests together. We should guard with a batching window cap and per-model sequence-length hist sampling. I can prototype a 10ms cap this week.

jen_l: From the model side, quantization fallback is also causing a small fraction of cross-kernel slowdowns. Medium-term: roadmap item to add a lightweight kernel compatibility matrix and automatic fallback ordering. Owner: jen_l + eng-runtime.

joel_s: SRE action: increase trace sampling for affected routes to 10% so we have better KV cache + kernel traces. I'll open the runbook PR and assign.

sam_p: Nice. Can you each put an expected measurable? e.g., reduce p99 by X ms or reduce regression occurrences by Y%?

maria_r: Short-term measurable: reduce the number of incidents triggered by p99 > 400ms on model-x from ~6/week to <=2/week. If it's a config hotfix, should be immediate. Medium-term measurable: end-to-end p99 improvement of 15–25% for model-x and model-y once kernel ordering + quant fallback lands.

kai_w: Prototype cap should cut the batching-induced extra latency by ~30% on synthetic tests for mixed seq lengths. Will validate against production traces before rollout.

jen_l: For the kernel compatibility matrix, expect initial MVP in 3–4 weeks that covers top 10 models and quant settings. Regression alerts tied to eval prompt sets will follow.

sam_p: Great. Two practical asks from PLG teams: 1) is there a temporary workaround they can use (e.g., model variant or request header) while we fix? 2) how should they notify if they see a regression?

maria_r: Workaround: add header X-Redwood-ServeHint: low_latency which forces split-by-length routing to the faster variant (falls back to default if capacity lacks). We'll document that in the console by EOD.

kai_w: Also advise teams to set prefer_cached: true for stable prompts to hit KV cache paths. That reduces tokens and latency for many flows.

joel_s: Notification path: open an 'incidents' thread and tag @eng-sre, but for visibility please also add the shortcut in the Console 'Report latency issue' which creates the ticket. I'll ensure the shortcut links to the new runbook.

sam_p: Any risk/rollback plan for the batching window cap?

maria_r: Risk: cap could increase CPU utilization (more smaller batches) hence cost. Rollback: revert cap flag (feature flag + canary) and route traffic to model-variant-fallback. We'll run canary at 5% then 25 then 100.

kai_w: Implementation note (snippet):

````
# pseudo-config for batching
batching:
  window_ms: 10  # canary value
  max_batch_size: 256
  split_by_seq_len: true
````

We'll expose as FF ‘batching.window_ms’ so ops can toggle without deploy.

jen_l: Small ask from research: we need evaluation hooks in the console to run regen tests automatically after rollout. If we can trigger a lightweight eval job post-rollout, we can detect quality regressions tied to quant/kernel changes. Owner: jen_l + product.

sam_p: Okay, action list summary?

maria_r: ACTION: triage p99 regressions + hotfix if config (owner: maria_r + joel_s) — ETA 7 days.

kai_w: ACTION: implement batching window FF + canary (owner: kai_w) — ETA 5 days for prototype, 2 weeks for full rollout.

jen_l: ACTION: start kernel compatibility matrix & console eval hooks (owner: jen_l) — ETA 3–4 weeks.

joel_s: ACTION: increase trace sampling + runbook PR + Console shortcut wiring (owner: joel_s) — ETA 3 days.

sam_p: I'll consolidate these into a GH project and ping leads for weekly check-ins. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: deploy 1895124000 to runtime-canary started by kai_w — status: in-progress

kai_w: quick update — canary is at 5% traffic and initial p95 looks stable. Will post numbers in #eng-runtime after 30m. :eyes:
